ARC-Managed ActionBarLayer Handle (Window-Aware)

Managed wrapper for ActionBarLayer. Tracks whether the action bar is attached to a Window to avoid destroying it while the window owns it.

Imports

../ffi, ../ffi/managed

Types

ActionBarLayerHandle = object
  pRaw*: ptr ActionBarLayer
  ownership*: HandleOwnership
  pParent*: ptr Layer
  attachedWindow*: ptr Window
